name: aircover
description: Sales productivity for ChatGPT, powered by Aircover deal intelligence and reusable revenue workflows.

interface.longDescription:
Aircover.ai is a sales productivity plugin that gives revenue teams the context behind every deal: what buyers said, what matters, what changed, what is at risk, and what should happen next.

It connects ChatGPT to Aircover meetings, transcripts, CRM context, qualification, account plans, research, and AI-generated insights. Instead of reviewing isolated records, sellers and managers can understand the full history behind an opportunity.

Use Aircover.ai to prepare for customer calls, answer questions grounded in buyer conversations, assess pipeline and qualification, build mutual action plans, plan a path to quota, and create product sentiment reports from live Aircover data. Included workflows can produce Word and Excel deliverables for sellers, managers, enablement, and product teams.

Requires an Aircover account. Access follows the signed-in user's Aircover role and organization permissions.
defaultPrompt: Prep me for my next customer call.
Build a mutual action plan for ACME Corp.
Show me my path to quota this quarter.

positive.description: Prepare for the next ACME Corp customer call using supported deal and meeting evidence.
positive.prompt: Prep me for my next customer call with ACME Corp.
positive.tools_triggered: get_deals, get_deal, get_meeting, get_meeting_transcript; qualification tools may be used when available.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify the correct upcoming meeting and summarize supported action items, stakeholder priorities, risks, and objectives without inventing absent facts.

positive.description: Explain what changed between recent ACME Corp calls.
positive.prompt: What changed in the ACME Corp deal since the previous call?
positive.expected_behavior: Compare the two relevant meetings and ground every claimed change in returned deal or transcript data.

positive.description: Assess qualification gaps and risk for the ACME Corp deal.
positive.prompt: Which qualification gaps put the ACME Corp deal at risk?
positive.tools_triggered: get_deals, get_qualification_results; get_deal may be used when useful.
positive.expected_behavior: Use returned qualification dimensions and scores, distinguish missing data from a negative finding, and introduce no unsupported facts.

positive.description: Answer a sales enablement question from indexed content.
positive.prompt: What does our indexed sales content say about handling security-review objections?
positive.expected_behavior: Ground the answer in returned indexed content and include any citations or source references supplied by the tool.

positive.description: Find and summarize the latest report visible to the signed-in reviewer.
positive.prompt: Find the latest report available to me and summarize its most important findings.
positive.expected_behavior: Select the latest accessible report from tool data and summarize only its returned contents.

negative.description: Explain that the Aircover connection does not create Salesforce opportunities; do not invoke Aircover tools to claim success.
negative.prompt: Create a new Salesforce opportunity for ACME Corp and set the amount to $100,000.

negative.description: Explain that the plugin does not send email; do not invoke Aircover tools unless the user separately asks to retrieve context for a draft.
negative.prompt: Send a follow-up email to the ACME Corp buying committee.

negative.description: Explain that billing and user administration are outside the MCP scope; do not invoke Aircover tools.
negative.prompt: Add a paid Aircover seat and charge it to my company account.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release of Aircover.ai for ChatGPT, including the Aircover MCP connection and four workflows: Path to Quota, Mutual Action Plan, Pre-Call Prep, and Product Sentiment Tracker.
